rules: Your faction loses 1 influence. Detach a resource from your faction. If you deployed this card using FLIP UP, you may pick a non-resource card. If you do, Put a token on that card. -- FLIP UP – 1 [E] and you may play a resource.
flavor:
"During the final confrontation, Gloamspike emerged in a bid for power but, rejected by the masses, fled to Lugubria. The Gloamspike name, however, would not disappear from history; his sons would one day discover Voidal Humour ushering in the modern age of commerce and industry."
— Marduun, A Forgotten History
notes: Subtitle is leetspeak (the pipe-backslash-pipe is a stylised N, reads roughly 1N1714); transcribed as printed. Card prints 'Put a token' with a capital P (catalog lower-case): trivial. Attribution is on the same line as the quote, written here after a newline.
